entities.summary: Pierre Allix was a French Protestant pastor and author. In 1690 Allix was created Doctor of Divinity by Emmanuel College, Cambridge, and was given the treasurership and a canonry in Salisbury Cathedral by Bishop Gilbert Burnet. He discovered that Codex Ephraemi is a palimpsest. Pierre Allix was a theologians & scholars from Alençon (1640-12-05, Alençon–1717-03-03). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
